endpoint: https://api.selectel.ru/ipam/v1 from URL table direct link to ip-addresses; schema-relative paths / and /{ptr_id}
auth: account static_token X-Token only; no IAM fallback

200.description: The PTR record has been returned.

400.description: Bad request. Fix the request and try again.

401.description: Bad or expired token. You can reissue the token and try again.

404.description: The PTR record has not been found.

422.description: Validation error. Fix the request and try again.

500.description: Server is not responding. Please try again later.

response.mapping: exact integer IDs/user_id/TTL; protected content; identity-first accepted receipt

retry: safe bounded reads only; no mutation replay
recovery: exact numeric provider ID only; no IP/name search or adoption
pagination: offset advances by observed item count until empty provider page; bounded prefixes; count-only response unknown
wait: existence/absence only, no reverse-DNS propagation claim
